$comment: Golden case-set for platform-identity-gate.schema.json. NOT a single canonical `.contract.json` (this profile encodes a 4-branch decision table; one instance cannot exhibit all branches), and deliberately named `.cases.json` so the top-level two-level `validate` glob (contracts/*/*.contract.json) does NOT pick it up — it is validated instead by the dedicated conformance test the enforcement plan prescribes (test_platform_identity_gate_conformance) which loads `pass`/`fail` arrays and asserts each element does/does-not validate. Every `pass` element MUST validate against the schema; every `fail` element MUST NOT — after the harness strips the `$case` annotation key (the schema is additionalProperties:false, so `$case` is a fixture label, not part of the instance). The tool ids and literals are the same cross-repo SSOT as mcp-plugin-delivery.contract.json.

pass.$case: not_platform — a plain workspace register that omits both tri-states is CORRECT (the legitimate case the base optionality exists for)
not_platform — a plain workspace heartbeat with no tri-states
failed — kind=platform register affirmatively reporting mcp_server_present=false (fail-closed, RCA #2970)
degraded — kind=platform heartbeat, mcp present true, loaded_mcp_tools OMITTED (pre-first-turn; held in provisioning, NOT failed — OMITTED != [] is load-bearing)
degraded — kind=platform heartbeat, mcp present true, loaded_mcp_tools present but WITHOUT the required provision_workspace tool (declared-but-not-loaded, #3082)
online — kind=platform heartbeat carrying the full verified-ready proof (mcp present + required tool loaded)

online heartbeat with MIXED tools (built-in a2a/Bash + the required mcp__ tool) — regression for the loaded_mcp_tools items-pattern over-constraint; real producers pass the runtime init tool list verbatim (workspace_test.go uses ['a2a', ...provision_workspace])

degraded heartbeat carrying a bare non-mcp__ tool id (e.g. 'provision_workspace' WITHOUT the mcp__molecule-platform__ prefix) — the required tool is ABSENT, so this is legitimately DEGRADED, not a wire error. Entries are free strings (real producers pass built-in ids); only membership of mcp__molecule-platform__provision_workspace gates online. Was previously a fail-case only because the removed per-entry mcpToolId pattern over-rejected it.

fail.$case: ANTI-VACUOUS #1 — a kind=platform heartbeat that omits BOTH tri-states must NOT be accepted as `online` (this is the exact bypass divergence #5 describes: the base schema validates it, this profile rejects the online claim)
ANTI-VACUOUS #2 — claiming `online` while loaded_mcp_tools lacks the required provision_workspace tool must be rejected
register can never be `online` (no loaded_mcp_tools field on the register struct — online is heartbeat-only)
`failed` verdict with mcp_server_present=true is a contradiction — false is the only fail-closed tri-state value (nil=allow, true=allow)
`degraded` verdict but the payload actually carries the required tool — that is `online`, not degraded (mislabeled verdict must be caught)
`not_platform` verdict but the payload IS kind=platform — the gate DOES apply, so the not-platform escape must be rejected
